mapper.select:
select question_id, title, category, reward_points, status, best_answer_id, ask_user_id, ask_nick_name, ask_avatar, ask_dept_name, view_count, answer_count, close_time, archive_time, tags, create_time from bbs_qa_question
del_flag = '0' and status = 'archived' and audit_status = 'approved'
and category = #{category}
and (title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or tags like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by view_count desc, archive_time desc order by archive_time desc

select question_id, title, content, category, reward_points, frozen_points, status, best_answer_id, ask_user_id, ask_nick_name, ask_avatar, ask_dept_name, visibility_scope, visibility_extra, expiry_time, close_time, archive_time, view_count, answer_count, audit_status, audit_reason, tags, create_time, update_time from bbs_qa_question where question_id = #{questionId} and del_flag = '0'

select answer_id, question_id, parent_answer_id, content, is_best, like_count, answer_user_id, answer_nick_name, answer_avatar, answer_dept_name, create_time, update_time from bbs_qa_answer where question_id = #{questionId} and del_flag = '0' order by is_best desc, like_count desc, create_time asc

select answer_id, question_id, parent_answer_id, content, is_best, like_count, answer_user_id, answer_nick_name, answer_avatar, answer_dept_name, create_time, update_time from bbs_qa_answer where answer_id = #{answerId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from bbs_qa_question where ask_user_id = #{askUserId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from bbs_qa_answer where answer_user_id = #{answerUserId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into bbs_qa_question( title, content, category, reward_points, frozen_points, status, ask_user_id, ask_nick_name, ask_avatar, ask_dept_name, visibility_scope, visibility_extra, expiry_time, audit_status, tags, create_by, create_time, update_time ) values( #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{rewardPoints}, #{frozenPoints}, #{status}, #{askUserId}, #{askNickName}, #{askAvatar}, #{askDeptName}, #{visibilityScope}, #{visibilityExtra}, #{expiryTime}, #{auditStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tags, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createBy}, now(), now() )

insert into bbs_qa_answer( question_id, parent_answer_id, content, is_best, like_count, answer_user_id, answer_nick_name, answer_avatar, answer_dept_name, create_by, create_time, update_time ) values( #{questionId}, #{parentAnswerId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{content}, '0', 0, #{answerUserId}, #{answerNickName}, #{answerAvatar, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{answerDeptName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createBy}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update bbs_qa_answer set is_best = '0', update_time = now() where question_id = #{questionId}
update bbs_qa_answer set is_best = '1', update_time = now() where answer_id = #{answerId}
update bbs_qa_question set status = 'solved', best_answer_id = #{bestAnswerId}, close_time = now(), update_time = now() where question_id = #{questionId}
update bbs_qa_question set audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_reason = #{auditReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_time = now() where question_id = #{questionId}
update bbs_qa_answer set del_flag = '2', update_time = now() where answer_id = #{answerId}
